_meanings:
A variety of diamonds capable of scratching on the surface
 of vessels; <ls>Kau. A. 2. 11. 29</ls>.
the world of inanimate things (<ab>opp.</ab> to {#sattvaloka#}); <ls>Buddh.</ls>

One of the ways of embezzlement, namely use of false
 cubic measures such as {#BAjana#}; <ls>Kau. A. 2. 8. 26</ls>.
